KaTeX 0.16.22 — https://katex.org — MIT licence (LICENSE in this folder).

Files kept from the npm package, unmodified: dist/katex.min.js,
dist/katex.min.css and the twenty .woff2 fonts in dist/fonts. The stylesheet
also names .woff and .ttf versions of each font; every browser the site
supports uses the .woff2 listed first, so those are left out. Loaded only by
src/site/math.js, on pages that show equations; nothing is fetched from a
CDN.

The Physium logo (assets/logo.svg) is the outline of \varphi (U+03C6) taken
from KaTeX's KaTeX_Math-Italic font, which is distributed under the same MIT
licence.
